chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all together from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
We found in the letter of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family): When adultery becomes prevalent after me, sudden death will increase.
And when they are insufficient in the measuring and the weighing, Allah will seize them with the years (of famine) and the shortages.
And when they withhold the Zakat, the earth will withhold its blessings from the crops, and the fruits, and the minerals, all of them.
And when they are tyrannical in their judgements, they will assist each other upon the injustices and the animosities.
And when they break the Covenant, Allah will cause their enemies to overcome upon them.
And when they sever the relationships, the wealth will be made to be in the hands of the most evil of them.

And when they do not enjoin with the good and do not forbid from the evil and do not follow the chosen ones from the People of my Household, Allah will cause the most evil of them to overcome upon them, so their best ones will be supplicating and it will not be Answered for them.
ai.seo_question: What are the consequences of adultery and withholding Zakat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Attributed to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) as a report from the 'Kitab al-Mahdi' (Book of the Progeny), this hadith details the causal link between communal moral decay and tangible divine retribution, such as sudden death and economic instability. It emphasizes that the failure to uphold justice and follow the Ahl al-Bayt leads to the dominance of the wicked and the rejection of the righteous's supplications, a concept central to Shia eschatology regarding the pre-Mahdi era.

en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and a number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from ibn Mahbub from Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “We have found in the book of the Messenger of Allah the following: after my leaving this world when fornication will turn out to be apparent among people, sudden death will take place more frequently.
When weighing and measurement will become light, people will face famine and shortages of livelihood.

When they deny paying al-Zakat (charity) the land will deny them its blessings of all of its farming, fruits and minerals. When people become unjust in their judgment, they will cooperate in injustice and animosity.
When they disregard their covenant, Allah will make their enemies dominate them.
When they fail to maintain good relations with relatives, properties will go in the hands of evildoers.

When people stop commanding the fulfillment of obligations and prohibiting the unlawful matters and do not follow the virtuous people of my family, Allah will make their evil people dominate them. Their virtuous ones will pray but their prayers will not be heard.”
